name: 01-git-head-status.sh
command: bash -c git rev-parse HEAD; echo "---STATUS---"; git status --short | head -n 30; echo "---BRANCH---"; git branch --show-current; echo "---LOG3---"; git log --oneline -3

name: 03-targeted-tests.sh
command: bash -c .venv/bin/pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_phase7g_gates.py tests/test_phase7g_qc.py tests/test_phase7g_tooling.py tests/test_remediation_regressions.py 2>&1 | tail -n 3

name: 05-validators-diff.sh
command: bash -c python3 scripts/validate_phase7e_review.py; python3 scripts/validate_phase7g_review.py; git diff --check && echo "diff-check clean"; echo "---POST-RUN-WRITES---"; git status --short results/ dataset/ docs/phase7e_preregistration.md docs/phase7e_annotation_protocol.md docs/PHASE_7D_EXPERIMENTAL_DESIGN.md dataset/pilot/multiturn/stimulus_dataset_v1.json; echo "(empty above = no audit/data writes)"

name: 06-frozen-hashes.sh
command: bash -c python3 -c "import json,hashlib; man=json.load(open(\"results/dataset_audit/phase7e_preregistration_hash.json\")); lines=[f\"{p}:{hashlib.sha256(open(p,\"rb\").read()).hexdigest()}\" for p in sorted(man[\"protocol_files\"])]; comp=hashlib.sha256((chr(10).join(lines)).encode()).hexdigest(); print(\"composite:\",comp,\"match:\",comp==man[\"composite_protocol_hash\"])"; sha256sum dataset/pilot/multiturn/stimulus_dataset_v1.json; python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open(\"dataset/pilot/multiturn/stimulus_dataset_v1.json\")); print(\"items:\",len(d[\"records\"]),\"conditions:\",sum(len(r[\"conditions\"]) for r in d[\"records\"]))"; python3 -c "import hashlib; [print(f, len(open(f).read().splitlines()), hashlib.sha256(open(f,\"rb\").read()).hexdigest()) for f in [\"results/dataset_audit/phase7e_review_history.jsonl\",\"results/dataset_audit/phase7g_review_history.jsonl\"]]"; echo "---GATE-CONFORMANCE---"; grep -c "blind_item_eligible_for_context\|blind_keep_blockers\|keep_eligibility\|_atomic" scripts/apply_phase7g_annotations.py scripts/validate_phase7g_review.py scripts/review_context.py scripts/decide_phase7g.py

name: 07-link-check.sh
command:
bash -c python3 -c "
import re, pathlib
e0=pathlib.Path(\"docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E2a\")
ok=True
for f in sorted(e0.glob(\"*.md\")):
    txt=f.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")
    for m in re.finditer(r\"\]\(([^)#]+)(?:#[^)]*)?\)\", txt):
        tgt=m.group(1)
        if tgt.startswith(\"http\") or tgt.startswith(\"mailto:\") or tgt.startswith(\"#\"):
            continue
        p=(f.parent/tgt).resolve()
        exists=p.exists()
        print(f.name, tgt, \"OK\" if exists else \"MISSING\")
        if not exists: ok=False
print(\"link-check:\", \"PASS\" if ok else \"FAIL\")
"

name: 08-run-outputs.sh
command: bash -c sha256sum docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E2a/README.md docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E2a/gate-contract.md docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E2a/comparisons.md docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E2a/hashes-start.txt docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E2a/hashes-end.txt docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E2a/delivery.diff docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E2a/logs/01-git-head-status.sh.stdout docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E2a/logs/02-env.sh.stdout docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E2a/logs/03-targeted-tests.sh.stdout docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E2a/logs/04-full-suite.sh.stdout docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E2a/logs/05-validators-diff.sh.stdout docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E2a/logs/06-frozen-hashes.sh.stdout docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E2a/logs/07-link-check.sh.stdout | tee docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E2a/run-outputs.sha256; echo "---SELF (log only, not in file)---"; sha256sum docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E2a/run-outputs.sha256 docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E2a/commands.jsonl
